Question: Fasting and purity 1) Does masturbation breaks the fast 2) does wet dream ahtilam breaks the fast? 3) during ghusl for gaining purity aftr ahtilam:if some one puts water in throat for gargles,does it effect our fast? If someone is sure tht water wil not go below throat thn it is allowed or not? Answer ID: 8000 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1832/1559=B/1429) (1) If semen was discharged due to masturbation the sawm (fast) will be broken. (2) The fast does not break by having a wet dream (ihtilam). (3) If the water reaches below the throat then the fast will be broken. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
